note: Synthetic algorithm fixture. These are not Noetic, Drive, Domain or Register operations and are not mapped to any CAS primitive.

data_register.qubits: lsb then msb, allocated by RegisterLayout

controlled_form: every gate of an instruction receives the slot's two opcode controls (positive for opcode bits equal to 1, negated for bits equal to 0); an unmet pattern leaves the data register untouched

classification_per_directive_section_4.admitted_CAS_operations: NONE inventoried; no approved source export supplied

invalid_encodings: none: two-bit opcodes and two-bit data cover exactly the four codes and four values
